adian system and the “when” we eat might play an important role in
obesity and metabolic dysfunction. Thus, we have described the impact of time-related eating patterns on weight-loss treatment,
and the differences between early eaters and late eaters. Therefore, changes in our behaviors toward early meals may improve
the weight-loss efﬁciency during the treatment. Finally, epigenetics shows that our behaviors can help to change our genome
and decrease the risk of several metabolic diseases.
